summary: Implemented the 4 shipping novel/transcendence commands the generator scaffolded as TODO stubs: history (cross-domain spend aggregation), pay wait (UPI payment long-poll), order verify-before-retry (safe-retry guard for non-idempotent order placement), and status (OAuth session health check). A 5th planned feature, instamart quick-reorder, was descoped mid-session (see Gaps in the shipcheck report) because this account has no Instamart order history to test against; its scaffold and code were removed.
reason: The generator produces Cobra wiring plus a TODO-error RunE body for novel commands; the actual feature logic must be hand-written per generator design.
validated_outcome: All 4 verified against real production data: history returned real cross-domain order counts/spend; status correctly reported real token expiry; order verify-before-retry correctly reconciled against real order history; pay wait's terminal-detection logic confirmed correct via direct inspection of a real check_payment_status response. Full live dogfood matrix 165/165, 0 hollow-coverage features.
